records.rationale: The flags-bearing getxattr interface/propagation from this version is absent after the final removal. Compared all distinct changed lines across the eight xattr-history candidates, full core VFS/header patches, all affected path blobs, and native/ACK final overlay helpers. The XATTR_NOSECURITY extension was removed by c4299f985785, including the later ext4 Hurd/incfs callback signatures. Neither pinned ACK nor this port defines XATTR_NOSECURITY. Keep native six-argument xattr_handler.get and five-argument __vfs_getxattr, with separate checked vfs_getxattr. Current overlay internal and user xattr reads use vfs_getxattr with mount idmaps and LSM checks in both final ACK and native LTS. No blanket skip of security checks is restored. Remaining deltas in F2FS/FUSE/incfs/kernfs/shmem/socket/SELinux are separate features, not this removed signature. Preserve native ACL rejection and newer trusted-xattr escape-prefix fix. Historical audit-log behavior has not been reproduced; final ACK and the positive current remounter policy are the compatibility evidence.

records.rationale: ACK fixes the guard for its fsverity hashtable semantics. This port deliberately retains native filesystem inode-info offsets: fsverity_active is exactly fsverity_get_info != NULL, and get_info checks IS_VERITY then loads the pointer with acquire ordering. Both guards load precisely a verity inode with no published info; d74c6ea9965e restores the native expression to minimize deviation. No verity verification, error handling or release/acquire publication is weakened. No runtime verity test.

review_method: Read all unique changed lines of the credential/xattr histories, complete final credential removal, complete core VFS xattr signature/dispatch patches, all four unique merge patches and all other small candidate patches. Compare complete final LTS/ACK/port overlay deltas. The repeated historical credential call-site rewrites were deduplicated for inspection; no claim of replaying or runtime testing old revisions.
security: Retain native dual permission checks, mount idmaps, cross-sb source checks, dentry lifetime and escaped-xattr prefix fixes; no additional credential or xattr-policy bypass. ACK guard is redundant under retained native fsverity semantics.
limits: SDK compilation/artifact generation only; no overlay mount/remount, SELinux, inotify or verity runtime test.
Older Android userspaces requiring the removed override_creds=off parameter are not the pinned target.
Embedded bug/report URLs in local commit messages were not accessed.
